title: Mixed Event — Musical Twilight Parade — Episode5 Making Memories!

meta.Event Outline: Shiho has been scouted by a band that's ready to make its big debut, giving her a lot to think about. Then, Saki invites her on a visit to Phoenix Wonderland. Meanwhile, Tsukasa and the rest of WxS make their own preparations, eager to host them!

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sigh... That was a lot scarier than I imagined...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Are you okay, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah... I was just surprised because I haven't gone to that many haunted houses before...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
The thing that poked my forehead...
I couldn't tell it was just konjac jelly at first!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That was actually pretty funny.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. Some effects were old-fashioned, but their simplicity added to the element of surprise. I've learned much from this experience.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Great! I can definitely handle something like that!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
You're volunteering?!
Then I'll prepare some piping hot konjac for you!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Why piping hot?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ahaha♪ Tsukasa looks like he's having fun!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: He would be with such interesting friends.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hm? Has that roller coaster always been there?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, I don't think so.
It must be new.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It feels different from everything else, doesn't it? That whole area seems to follow more of a futuristic theme.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
There are more thrill rides than before too.
And they all look pretty scary...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Does that mean they made a new area?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Right, I'm sure Emu would know!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Emu, do you know anything about that roller coaster...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, um...! If you're looking for a fun roller coaster, I recommend the Go! Go! Phenny! coaster over there☆ Come on, let's gooo!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? O-Okay? Uh, let's go...!
Roller Coaster
se_event_parade_2021_002

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Build suspense by pausing just before the drop...
And then...
se_event_parade_2021_003

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As the coaster speeds up during the drop, riders are treated to a view of Phoenix Wonderland in its full glory...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The exhilaration one feels after being liberated from that initial tension... What a wonderful setup, indeed.

rows.Speaker: Honami & Ichika
rows.Line: AAAHHHHHHHH!!!
se_event_parade_2021_003
Coffee Cup

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Round and round and round and round!
Gaaaaaah!!!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Waaaargh! This is amazing, Tsukasa!
The whole world's spinning like crazy♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Ts-Tsukasa!
This is a bit too much, don't you think?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No! We can do even better!! Let it be known that I settle for nothing but the best performance in everything I do!!!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Well, they seem to be having a fun time...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa definitely is.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We don't have to compete with them, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ahaha♪
Ferris Wheel

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We're almost at the top, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wow...
PXL looks so different from up here!
Isn't this amazing?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We can take our time with the view here, unlike the roller coaster.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I could stay on that ride forever♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um, I think I'm okay for now...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Phew... That was certainly a lot of fun.
Shall we find a place to rest for a bit.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Why don't we get some Phenny Penguin manju?
There's a set that comes with drinks too☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Sounds like a plan. Wait here for me.
I'll go get some for everyone.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you so much...!
You're so thoughtful.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thanks, Tsukasa!
See you later!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's already this late...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We haven't had so much fun at PXL together since we were in elementary school.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know, right! It feels kinda weird because we'd usually still be practicing.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
You're right.
But I feel like playing the guitar now, actually.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Me too! I've been tapping to a rhythm for a while already...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You too, Hona?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. I'm still a terrible drummer who always relies on Shiho, but I just want everyone to know that I really love our band!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's nice...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
By the way...
When did you start playing the bass, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I vaguely remember it was from elementary school...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hey, I've been curious about that too!
All of a sudden, you just started playing one day!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Did it seem like that?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like to know too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's nothing that dramatic really...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You know my father's a musician, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! He's a guitarist, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Right, and he took me along to see all sorts of shows when I was still little.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Then I saw a girl band perform...
Their show was just so cool and amazing...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really? I didn't know that! What did they sound like?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You should be able to find them with a quick search. They turned pro just a little while ago.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I can also lend you their CD if you're really interested.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, really?! Thanks, Shiho!
I can't wait♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Would you mind if I borrow it afterwards?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sure. They've gotten better since turning pro too, so we could definitely use their performances as a reference.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They must be really good for you praise them like this.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes. I respect them.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Their music has a way of really getting my heart going...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
It makes me want to shout out or cry...
I just can't sit still after listening to them...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wow...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And I want to touch someone's heart with my music, like they did with mine.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
That's why I have to get better...
I want to become a pro and reach more people.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So that my music can really get them going too...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Now I understand...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
A professional, huh?
I've never thought about that before.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We'd probably have to practice even harder than we are right now...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yikes... That sounds rough...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I should've known... None of them are thinking about aiming higher, are they?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I can't even begin to imagine what the world of professional musicians is like...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But it has to be fun if it allows more people to listen to our music, like Shiho says.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But I'd have to get much better first...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Is it just me or did their conversation become somber all of the sudden?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's not just you. I can't hear them clearly, but it sounds quite serious.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They're in a band together, yes? I'm sure they have quite a lot to talk about since they're dedicated to the same craft and all.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Gasp...! Guys, it's almost time for the show to start!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What? Already?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, she's right.
Shall we start getting ready then?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki! We're heading to Wonder Stage to get ready for the show!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Come and watch us later!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Okay, got it!
Break a leg, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And everyone from Wonderlands×Showtime too!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I know you'll love our show!
I guarantee it'll make you grin from ear to ear☆
